proposals.title: Report on Sugar and Public Health
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report, with independent scientist input, on sugar products marketed to consumers and children, assessing financial and reputational risks from changing science on sugar.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends voting AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Report on Antibiotics and Public Health Costs
proposals.proponent: The Shareholder Commons, representing Trinity College Cambridge and Amundi Asset Management
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to commission and disclose a study on external environment and public health costs created by antibiotic use in the supply chain.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends voting AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Request for Shareholders to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Requests that the board permit shareholders to act by written consent by the minimum votes needed to authorize action at a meeting.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends voting AGAINST this proposal.
